fixed_findings.fix: Replace every stress acceptance assert with explicit ValueError checks. Resource test compares exact names and per-file sizes and cleanup; inventory tool verifies ready/count/capacity/private residue before emitting frozen_verifier_passed phase.
fixed_findings.impact: Offline proof tools only. Does not establish that earlier normal-mode measurements were incorrect; it closes optimization-mode false-pass behavior.
fixed_findings.acceptance: In optimized child processes, missing expansion, redistributed sizes with equal total, wrong names, wrong fixture descriptor, false-ready, wrong source capacity, private residue and cleanup failure all reject; both complete optimized stress runs pass genuine execution.

fixed_findings.fact: Inner ZIP preflight accepted BZIP2/LZMA. Declared output byte caps alone do not bound every codec decoder auxiliary memory requirement.

fixed_findings.fix: Reject inner members outside STORE/DEFLATE and encrypted members before frozen parsing.
fixed_findings.impact: Consumer preflight only. Frozen producer explicitly emits DEFLATE; existing STORE synthetic fixtures remain supported. No observed production corruption or measured memory exhaustion is claimed.
fixed_findings.acceptance: Small BZIP2/LZMA fixtures reject before frozen verifier and single semantic verifier; encryption flag rejects; STORE and DEFLATE pass full single stage and pre-upload semantics.
